purpose: Crosswalk the global freshwater drainage-basin dataset candidate Neostethus villadolidi for northern Luzon Cagayan basin B0380 against the historical type locality, a published Philippine type checklist, the 2021 IUCN range assessment, and a bounded GBIF query.

candidate.basinScope: Northern Luzon drainage basin; its polygon is not Cagayan de Misamis in Mindanao.
candidate.globalDatasetRole: Basin-level distribution candidate only. The source workbook defines referenceIds as taxonomic bibliography but does not map each reference to a basin association; this is not a dated specimen record or basin-specific citation crosswalk.

taxonomicCrosscheck.interpretation: The exact GBIF name match supplies a query key only; it is not an independent taxonomic review or occurrence assertion.

distributionAssessment.citation: Torres, A. G., Leander, N. J. S., & Kesner-Reyes, K. (2021). Neostethus villadolidi. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species 2021: e.T90985656A90985660. https://doi.org/10.2305/IUCN.UK.2021-1.RLTS.T90985656A90985660.en.
rangeLocalitiesAsListed: Dumague and Siaton, Negros Oriental (spelling retained as in assessment)
distributionAssessment.sourceRetrieval: Assessment full text was reviewed from a ResearchGate-hosted copy; official DOI and IUCN landing page were retained. No assessment PDF or map is stored in this repository.
distributionAssessment.scopeLimit: This is the assessment’s locality summary citing Parenti (1989), not a current field survey or complete watershed checklist. The assessment is Data Deficient; omission of northern Luzon does not establish absence.
distributionAssessment.rangeStatementCaveat: The IUCN locality list reflects the 2020 assessment and is not exhaustive proof of where the species can or cannot occur. “Dumague” is retained as spelled in the assessment and is not normalized to another locality here.

boundedCoordinateQuery.searchArea: B0380 bounding rectangle; not the polygon itself

gbifCrossCheck.interpretation: GBIF returned zero coordinates for this exact taxon key in the selected rectangle. This is a bounded index count at the checked time, not an absence assessment and not a complete B0380 search.

localityResolution.localityNameCollision: The shared word Cagayan in Cagayan de Misamis/Cagayan de Oro refers to a Mindanao locality in the reviewed type and assessment sources. B0380 is the separate Cagayan drainage basin in northern Luzon.
localityResolution.basinAssociation: Unverified. No reviewed source provides a Neostethus villadolidi specimen/event explicitly located in the northern Luzon Cagayan drainage or links the global dataset bibliography IDs to B0380.
localityResolution.absenceConclusion: None. A locality missing from a range summary and a zero-result GBIF query do not show absence from Cagayan basin or Luzon.
localityResolution.placeNameCollision: Cagayan de Misamis in the type series is a Mindanao locality, distinct from the northern Luzon Cagayan basin. Parenti (1989) also gives the broad phrase “throughout Philippines”, but its examined material and explicit island-level distribution are not a Cagayan River or northern Luzon sampling record.

interpretation: The basin dataset’s eight-name list is a discovery screen, not a complete inventory; its reference IDs are not linked to individual basins.
GBIF returns an exact accepted name key, but that is a search key rather than an independent taxonomic or occurrence assertion.

The Cagayan de Misamis type locality is in Mindanao. Parenti (1989) uses a broad “throughout Philippines” range phrase, while its examined vouchers/locality statements name Mindanao, Negros Oriental, Mactan/Cebu, Cuyo/Palawan, and Leyte without a specific northern Luzon locality.
The 2021 IUCN assessment lists named localities across the same islands and is Data Deficient. Neither its omissions nor the broader historical phrase establish presence or absence in B0380.
The basin-specific source association remains unverified because the global dataset does not map its bibliography references to individual basins.
No public species row, occurrence, basin geometry, diet, bait, catchability, legal, safety, or app content was added.
